title: Email Not Syncing — Microsoft Outlook / Exchange Online
error_codes: Error 0x800CCC0E: Connection to the server failed
Error 0x8004010F: Outlook data file cannot be accessed
diagnostic_questions: Can you access your email via Outlook Web (outlook.office.com)?
Did this start after a recent Windows update or Outlook update?
Are you seeing any specific error messages?
Is the issue happening for just you or your entire team?

diagnostic_tools.purpose: Verify user has active Exchange mailbox

resolution_steps.action: Check if Outlook is working in offline mode. Look at the bottom status bar — if it says 'Working Offline', go to the Send/Receive tab and click 'Work Offline' to toggle it off.
resolution_steps.checkpoint: Does the status bar now show 'Connected to: Microsoft Exchange'?

resolution_steps.action: Try accessing your email at outlook.office.com in a web browser. Sign in with your corporate credentials.
resolution_steps.checkpoint: Can you see your emails in the web version?

resolution_steps.action: If web mail works but Outlook doesn't, restart Outlook. Close it fully (check Task Manager to ensure OUTLOOK.EXE is not running), then reopen it.
resolution_steps.checkpoint: Is Outlook now syncing your emails?

resolution_steps.action: Clear the Outlook credential cache. Go to Control Panel → Credential Manager → Windows Credentials. Remove any entries related to 'MicrosoftOffice' or 'outlook'. Restart Outlook and re-enter your credentials.
resolution_steps.checkpoint: Did Outlook prompt for credentials and then connect successfully?

resolution_steps.action: If web mail is also not working, check your account status. Your account may be locked or your password may have expired. Try resetting your password at passwordreset.corporate.com.
resolution_steps.checkpoint: Were you able to reset your password and access web mail?

escalation_criteria: If Outlook and web mail are both failing, or if Exchange Online service is confirmed degraded
